mustFix.issue: Opening or creating a project silently discards the current unsaved edits and their undo history.
mustFix.reproduction: Open project A, add a clip or change camera metadata without Save, click project B or Create project, then reopen A. The edit is gone; beforeunload never runs for an in-app switch.
mustFix.evidence: Both switch handlers call accept directly; accept replaces history with createHistoryState. Only browser unload checks history.past.length.
mustFix.fix: Route create/open through a common project-switch guard that saves the current dirty project before replacement or offers explicit save/discard/cancel. Preserve current state when saving or opening fails.

mustFix.issue: Ctrl+D modifies a locked track, although the Duplicate context-menu item is disabled for that track.
mustFix.reproduction: Select a clip, lock its track, focus the timeline, press Ctrl+D. duplicateClip appends a copy to the locked track through onBatchUpdateClips.
mustFix.evidence: Keyboard handler line 809 invokes duplicateClip without a lock check; duplicateClip itself has no check. main.tsx updateClips accepts changes on locked tracks.
mustFix.fix: Enforce the lock check inside duplicateClip and preferably at the central clip mutation boundary so every invocation obeys the same rule.

mustFix.issue: Preview plays embedded video sound, but export excludes that sound and the UI tells users to add explicit audio.
mustFix.reproduction: Import a video containing audio, add it to the picture track and Play. PreviewPlayer starts the unmuted video at volume 1. Export the same project without an explicit audio clip; the renderer produces no audio stream.
mustFix.evidence: Video creation sets muted=false at line 370; lines 587-598 play both video and audio. core/render.ts 114-134 adds audio only for assets whose kind is audio.
mustFix.fix: Mute video elements in this preview integration and play only explicit audio assets, matching the documented renderer contract.

mustFix.issue: Multiple active clips referencing the same audio/video asset share one playback element, so their independent source offsets cannot be previewed or mixed.
mustFix.reproduction: Add one audio asset to two audio tracks with overlapping clips and different source offsets. While playing, both active clips retrieve the same HTMLAudioElement and overwrite its currentTime; only one audio source plays. Export creates a distinct input per clip and mixes both.
mustFix.evidence: mediaElementsRef is keyed by media item id, allocation creates one element per asset, and activeClips retrieves that shared element at line 566 before seeking it at line 594.
mustFix.fix: Manage audio/video playback instances per timeline clip, keeping images shared if desired. Pause and dispose instances when clips disappear or the component unmounts.

worthConsidering.issue: Portrait or square video is cropped vertically in preview while export fits the entire frame.
worthConsidering.reproduction: Import a 9:16 video into the default 1280x720 project. Preview scales it to width 1280 and height about 2276, clipping most of the frame; export force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease fits it to about 405x720.
worthConsidering.fix: Use the image branch's contain calculation for video and transition video rendering too. Video qualification is explicitly partial, but the current import control exposes this discrepancy.

worthConsidering.issue: Timeline seeks while playing are overwritten by the transport timer's original position; edits that change duration during playback also retain the original end time.
worthConsidering.reproduction: Play a multi-second timeline and click its ruler or use Go to start/end. onPlayheadUpdate changes playhead, but the next 33ms timer tick restores at+elapsed. Add or shorten a clip during playback; total remains the value captured when playback began.
worthConsidering.fix: Pause on timeline seeking, or maintain a transport origin ref updated by seek operations and recompute duration when the timeline changes.
